text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the modern workplace. One of its biggest impacts is automation, where AI handles repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling, freeing employees for more creative work. Beyond this, AI-powered productivity tools can analyze large amounts of information, summarize reports, and even draft emails, saving valuable time. However, the goal isn't to replace humans but to enable human-AI collaboration. By working alongside these systems, people can make better decisions. This shift does mean job changes; some roles will disappear, but new ones will emerge, requiring skills in managing and training AI. Ultimately, the key lies in adapting and learning to work effectively with our new digital colleagues.
